versions.content: If development error detection for the Ttcan module is en- abled: The function Can_TTGetErrorLevel() shall raise the error CAN_E_PARAM_- POINTER and shall return E_NOT_OK if the parameter Can_TTErrorLevel is a NULL pointer.
